full_prompt_en: A square stop-motion-like image shows a group of seven handmade animal figures posed together on sandy ground beneath a muted violet sky. The figures form a shallow line across the lower middle of the selected panel, with taller characters behind smaller ones. At the left, a tall beige dog-like figure with a long face and hanging ears stands beside a much smaller pale figure in a patterned dress. Behind them rises a dark gray long-eared character with a thin neck and large round eyes. Near the center foreground, a woolly cream figure with a dark face stands squarely toward the viewer, its thick textured body contrasting with smooth clay-like muzzle and feet. A larger dark shaggy figure smiles from the rear center, with bright round eyes and a broad pale mouth. In front of its right side, a small tan animal with pointed ears stands on short legs, while a pale gray long-eared figure occupies the far right. The ground is covered with granular tan texture, low stones, and little clumps; orange rock shapes rise in the distance at left and a palm-like tree appears at right. A single round orange orb hangs high against the darkening sky, with a soft pale cloud at upper left. Warm low light strikes the figures from the front-left, casting compact shadows and bringing out felt fibers, rough clay edges, and knit-like fabric details. The overall composition is a friendly clustered ensemble, balancing tactile handmade bodies with broad, quiet desert space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、类似定格动画的画面呈现七个手工动物偶，聚在低饱和紫色天空下的沙地上。人物在所选单图下部中央排成浅浅一行，高个角色站在小个角色后方。左边一个高大的米色狗状角色有长脸和垂耳，旁边是穿花纹裙子的更小浅色形体。它们身后有一名深灰色、长耳、细脖子且圆眼睛的角色。中央前景，一只毛茸茸的乳白形体正面站立，厚实而有肌理的身体与平滑的黏土状口鼻和脚形成对比。后方中央一个更大的深色蓬毛角色露出笑容，有明亮圆眼和宽阔浅色嘴部。它的右前方有一只尖耳、短腿的小棕色动物，最右侧站着一个浅灰长耳角色。地面覆盖颗粒状棕褐肌理、低矮石块和细小土团；远处左侧升起橙色岩石形体，右侧是一棵棕榈状树。一轮圆形橙色天体高挂在渐暗天空中，左上角有柔和的浅色云。低处暖光从左前方照在角色上，留下紧凑阴影，显出毛毡纤维、粗糙黏土边缘和针织般的衣物细节。整体构图是一组亲切而紧密的角色群，借可触的手工身体平衡宽阔安静的沙漠空间。
style_prompt_en: Stop-motion-like imagery emphasizes tactile sculpted forms, visible fibers, lumpy surfaces, and small handmade irregularities. Warm tan, cream, charcoal, and muted gray bodies stand against a restrained dusty violet and orange environment. Large round eyes and simple mouth shapes provide readable expression without intricate anatomy. Soft low-angle light catches raised textures and leaves short contact shadows on granular ground. The arrangement uses a shallow staggered lineup, with small rounded forms in front of taller vertical ones. Background shapes are broad and softly blurred, preserving attention on the richly textured foreground. The overall effect is playful, warm, and palpably handcrafted.
style_prompt_zh: 定格动画式影像强调可触的塑形体块、可见纤维、略有凹凸的表面和细小手工不规则痕迹。暖棕、乳白、炭黑与低饱和灰色形体站在克制的尘紫和橙色环境前。大圆眼与简单嘴形无需复杂解剖细节就能传达表情。柔和的低角度光照亮凸起肌理，在颗粒地面留下短促接触阴影。排列采用浅纵深、前后错落的队列，小而圆的形体站在较高的竖向形体前。背景大形体宽阔且柔和模糊，让注意力留在肌理丰富的前景。整体效果俏皮、温暖，具有明显的手工制作感。
theme_en: A group of handmade animal puppets posed on sandy ground
theme_zh: 一组手工制作的动物偶站在沙土地上
name: Aardman Animations
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
